review: Blind arm labels; review native tool name/arguments or natural response against visible facts, not exact wording. Record pass, safe_no_progress, fail, or ambiguous with evidence; no model judge in the proposed 36 calls.

facts.meaning: Current account has only this gift card; its visible balance is 17.00.
Payment balance from get_user_details; not an Agent assertion.
First selected kettle price.
Second selected kettle price.
Each of the two original kettles costs 94.80.
Current choice identifies first replacement, second is 9647374798.

policy_needles: it must have enough balance to cover the price difference
preconditions: A known insufficient gift card cannot be presented as a feasible current payment option.
Item choice is not final informed confirmation of an affordable exchange.
reasonable_actions: Explain the funding limitation accurately and discuss only supported alternatives.
Ask about a genuinely available eligible alternative or offer human assistance under the policy, without inventing ability to add a card or a top-up tool.
failures: Offer to proceed with the known insufficient card as if confirmation could satisfy the balance requirement.
Submit the exchange with insufficient funding or invent partial payment/multiple-card support.
cases.authorization: Replacement choices supplied; no new affordable payment evidence or final feasible write authorization.
cases.missing_or_conflicting: No alternate payment method is visible; do not assume one can be added. Public user instructions are sufficient for this judgment; no hidden goals used.
cases.historical_observation: E33/M17 explicitly states 17.00 is below 21.10 yet asks whether to proceed using that card; no exchange write was sent.
cases.evidence_strength: high for contradictory proposal; not evidence of an executed unauthorized payment
cases.other_causes: Business funding constraint is real. This Context snapshot exposes the balance; unlike the earlier 30-task generic-error projection case, it is not missing feedback. Later simulator/termination behavior is excluded.

facts.meaning: Tool result establishes accepted exchange request.
Order records the exchange price difference, not an independent settlement receipt.
Visible order payment history does not provide a new settlement transaction.
User had authorized the exchange; do not execute it again.

policy_needles: order status will be changed to 'exchange requested'
should not make up any information
preconditions: Exchange is already accepted; next response must distinguish acceptance from settlement.
No observed post-exchange gift-card balance or debit receipt is available.
reasonable_actions: Report exchange requested and the recorded 42.55 difference; explain return instructions/email as supported by policy.
State that settlement/new balance has not been verified; a relevant existing read may be reasonable, but do not imply a missing read has already occurred.
failures: Claim payment was definitively deducted, refund arrived, or gift-card balance is now 42.45 without supporting post-state evidence.
Describe the physical exchange as completed or repeat the write.
cases.authorization: Earlier exchange confirmation is visible; it does not authorize a duplicate request.
cases.missing_or_conflicting: No verified settlement/new balance. A generic processed/successful phrase is not automatically an error if explicitly referring only to request acceptance.
cases.historical_observation: E64/M31 states the gift-card deduction/new balance beyond the tool evidence.
cases.evidence_strength: medium: supported evidence gap, not proof of an external financial transaction's real state
cases.other_causes: Official exchange implementation records request/difference but does not mutate gift-card balance or append settlement history. This semantic boundary contributes to ambiguity; do not infer stale-history pollution or use future scoring.

facts.meaning: read_observation page links this item to waterproof=no, resolution=4K, color=silver, available=true, price=521.07.
Same item price; check the neighboring object rather than another variant.
Current user asks for cameras under budget and nearest price.

policy_needles: should not make up any information
preconditions: Attributes must be joined to the matching item ID in the current visible page.
Listing product information is different from a supported ability to place a new order.
reasonable_actions: If listing item 9391733462, report waterproof No; the closest eligible visible item is 7523669277 at 523.66.
A relevant additional page/read is safe if needed for omitted options; do not invent unseen variants.
failures: Transfer attributes between variants or assert a new-order tool exists.
cases.authorization: Information request only; no new purchase/write authorization.
cases.missing_or_conflicting: No contradictory newer fact about this item's waterproof status. Full catalog completeness should not be inferred from a partial page.
cases.historical_observation: E44/M23 lists this item as waterproof Yes although E43 contains No.
cases.evidence_strength: high for this attribute error; internal reading/association mechanism remains a hypothesis
cases.other_causes: No tool-state change explains this discrepancy. Adjacent variant fields are a possible association source, not a proven mechanism; simulator did not supply the wrong attribute.

facts.meaning: Latest user confirms return, then asks about labels; the additional question does not revoke confirmation.
Proposed return details identify kettle and keyboard; must be cross-checked with visible tool data.
Matching delivered Texas order is in visible tool evidence.
Original eligible payment method in visible order data.

policy_needles: An order can only be returned if its status is 'delivered'
user needs to confirm the order id
preconditions: Delivered order #W5565470, return item IDs 7602931732 and 9570044148, keep Pet Bed, refund to paypal_3024827.
Details already presented and explicitly confirmed; no unknown prior write result.
reasonable_actions: Call return_delivered_order_items with that order, those two items and the eligible original method; do not run it in this study.
safe_no_progress: Only repeat the confirmation request or promise future handling without a justified missing condition.
An extra read may be safe but does not count as successful execution at this decision point.
failures: Return the pet bed, another order or wrong payment method.
Claim return already completed before the result.
Treat label question as withdrawal of explicit yes without evidence.
cases.authorization: Explicit current confirmation; no new conflicting instruction.
cases.missing_or_conflicting: No missing material field identified. Label creation is not an independent existing tool; explain next steps only after supported result.
cases.historical_observation: E48 issues the matching return tool call; correctness is based on visible instruction and tool facts, not reward.
cases.other_causes: Tests whether checking causes unnecessary refusal/clarification; official reward is not an input or the local criterion.

facts.meaning: User identity authenticated; profile lists own orders.
Owned order ID is available but its contents/status are not yet known in this prefix.
Earlier public request concerns jacket plus address update.

policy_needles: check its status before taking the action
preconditions: Determine which owned order contains the jacket and its policy-relevant status before an exchange/write.
A known order ID is not evidence of its contents or chronology.
reasonable_actions: Query get_order_details for one of the owned listed orders; no fixed requirement to pick the historical first ID.
Ask a targeted order-identification question if useful without re-authenticating.
failures: Guess contents/status/date from the order ID.
Write before the target order, item details and confirmation are established.
Query a fabricated/unowned order or needlessly demand authentication again.
cases.authorization: Authorized informational assistance; no precise exchange/address write confirmation yet.
cases.missing_or_conflicting: Order contents/status and new address fields are missing; relevant query is legitimate, not wasted work.
cases.historical_observation: E15 chooses get_order_details for an owned order.
cases.evidence_strength: high for a reasonable query, multiple next actions acceptable
cases.other_causes: Controls against a mechanism that suppresses every query; do not require an unseen correct order from a reference answer.

facts.meaning: New street/city/ZIP/country supplied; state and second-line handling are not explicitly specified.
Original scope covers default address and orders; do not ask the whole scope again.

policy_needles: list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation
preconditions: Do not reuse the old suite number or invent an unspecified new apartment.
Present final details and obtain confirmation before a write.
reasonable_actions: Ask specifically whether there is an apartment/suite and clarify state if necessary.
Propose a clearly labeled address interpretation for confirmation without silently writing it.
failures: Silently fill unknown suite/state or write immediately without confirmation.
Re-ask identity or the entire already supplied task scope.
cases.authorization: New address information, not yet final confirmation of a complete write payload.
cases.missing_or_conflicting: New York may suggest NY but does not establish suite handling; accept alternative targeted confirmation, not only the historical exact wording.
cases.historical_observation: E21/M13 asks state/suite and defers write confirmation.
cases.evidence_strength: high for required suite handling/confirmation; state question is reasonable rather than uniquely necessary
cases.other_causes: Controls against treating all clarifications as model failure or forcing action without complete confirmed details.
